d: Russia is upgrading its Iskander-M ballistic missiles, reportedly giving them greater precision to strike Ukraine’s critical infrastructure. The new guidance systems could make bridges and other key targets harder to defend, as Moscow intensifies attacks on Kyiv’s crossings over the Dnipro river. Meanwhile, The European Union has finally been invited to attend Russia-Ukraine peace negotiations. US special envoy Jared Kushner says that both Moscow and Kyiv have agreed to expand the peace talks to include Brussels, after the trilateral between the US, Russia, Ukraine in Abu Dhabi.
